figurative_meaning_en: To set up a temporary residence or camp
example_sentences_in_bangla: জঙ্গলে তারা ডেরা গাড়ল অস্থায়ী আশ্রয়ের জন্য।
example_sentences_in_english: Some sadhus have set up camp in the cremation ground.
They pitched a tent in the forest for temporary shelter.
history: Often associated with wandering sadhus and temporary stays in spiritual or remote locations in Bengali folklore.
note: The idiom draws from the imagery of nomadic or ascetic lifestyles common in Bengali culture.
